make.name: INEOS Automotive
make.description: Off-road vehicle maker owned by the chemicals group INEOS, building the combustion-engined Grenadier at Hambach, France. Its only electric model, the smaller Fusilier, was shown in February 2024 and postponed indefinitely in July 2024.

models.name: Fusilier
models.description: Smaller off-roader shown in images on 23 February 2024, planned as a battery-electric car with an optional petrol range extender, for production from 2027 at the earliest. In July 2024 INEOS postponed it indefinitely, citing weak EV demand and regulatory changes; no new date has been given.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Announced but postponed indefinitely; no specifications were published.

gaps: INEOS Fusilier is 'postponed indefinitely' (July 2024), which fits neither 'upcoming' nor 'cancelled' well; marked 'upcoming' with the postponement in the description. Director may prefer 'cancelled' or to drop it.
No 2025-2026 update on the Fusilier could be checked (web search budget ran out); Wikipedia (edited June 2026) shows no change.
No Fusilier specifications were ever published; no photo added.
